svg.text: Review pull requests of any size in parts
feat: Add repository context and scale large reviews

g.title: risk 1: Shared names can credit the wrong caller (wrong answer, possible, reaches many, caused by service)
risk 2: Default reading budget raised to 50,000 tokens (degraded, always, reaches everyone, caused by deploy)
B1: A change too large for one call failed → Reviewed in up to 64 parts
B2: Each part saw only its own diff → Changed functions bring their callers
